benchmarks.name: PutnamBench
benchmarks.description: Lean theorem proving on Putnam Mathematical Competition problems. Pass rate = N solved / total problems. Used by formal proof systems (DeepSeek-Prover, Goedel-Prover, AlphaProof).

scores._note: DeepSeekMath-V2 Putnam 2024 = 118/120 = 98.33% (with scaled test-time compute). Per HuggingFace + paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.22570.
DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B solved 49 of 658 problems on PutnamBench = 7.45%. Lean theorem proving specialist. Paper arxiv 2504.21801.
Goedel-Prover-V2-32B solved 86 of 660 PutnamBench problems = 13.03% (pass@184 with error correction). Outperforms DeepSeek-Prover-V2-671B (49/658=7.45%) and Kimina-Prover-72B.
